title: Siguran dizajn, modeli sigurnosti i ranjivosti arhitektura
summary: Principi sigurnog dizajna i Zero Trust, threat modeling, modeli Bell-LaPadula, Biba, Clark-Wilson i Brewer-Nash, izbor kontrola (RMF, Common Criteria), TCB, reference monitor, TPM i HSM, te ranjivosti i mitigacije od baza i kontejnera do OT/ICS, clouda i kvantnih prijetnji.
title_en: Secure Design, Security Models and Architecture Vulnerabilities
summary_en: Secure design principles and Zero Trust, threat modeling, the Bell-LaPadula, Biba, Clark-Wilson and Brewer-Nash models, control selection (RMF, Common Criteria), TCB, reference monitor, TPM and HSM, and vulnerabilities and mitigations from databases and containers to OT/ICS, cloud and quantum threats.
